description: This Java class, SearchModelFactory, provides static factory methods to create and manipulate search-related objects such as SearchResult, SearchFilter, SearchProperty, SearchQuery, and various options like SortOption, LimitOption, SizeOption, and CursorOption. It acts as a utility class for constructing search models used within the Ditto project, facilitating the creation of search criteria, results, and query parameters.

classes.name: SearchModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating and combining search-related objects such as SearchResult, SearchFilter, SearchProperty, and search options. Facilitates building search queries and results in the Ditto project.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult with specified items and a next page offset.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult initialized from a JsonObject.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new SearchResult from a JSON string.

methods.name: newSearchResultBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing SearchResult objects.

methods.name: newSearchResultBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized from an existing SearchResult.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a LogicalSearchFilter combining provided filters with AND.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a LogicalSearchFilter combining provided filters with OR.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a LogicalSearchFilter that negates the given filter.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty for a given JSONPointer or property path.

methods.name: newSearchQuery
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery based on a given SearchFilter.

methods.name: newSearchQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for a SearchQuery, initialized with a SearchFilter.

methods.name: newSortOption
methods.description: Creates a SortOption from a list of SortOptionEntries.

methods.name: newSortOption
methods.description: Creates a SortOption with a single property path and order.

methods.name: newSortOptionEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOptionEntry for a given property path and order.

methods.name: newSortOptionEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOptionEntry for a given order and property path (deprecated).

methods.name: newLimitOption
methods.description: Creates a LimitOption with specified offset and count.

methods.name: newSizeOption
methods.description: Creates a SizeOption with the specified maximum size.

methods.name: newCursorOption
methods.description: Creates a CursorOption with the specified cursor string.
